title.narrative: Winterhilfe für von der Dürre betroffene Gemeinden in den Provinzen Samangan und Jawzjan, Afghanistan

description.narrative: Die vorgeschlagene Intervention zielt darauf ab, die Landwirtschaft und die Viehzucht wiederherzustellen, indem sie den betroffenen Gemeinden über den Winter hilft und so die Auswirkungen der Dürre auf das Jahr 2019 mildert.

Impact: To contribute to ending hunger and safeguarding the livelihoods of the drought-affected people in North Afghanistan; To ensure target groups has safe, nutritious and sufficient food all year round. Outcome: Drought-affected families in Jawzjan and Samangan have improved food and nutrition security and restored livelihoods.

Total Participants : 21,000 . 3,000 households with in total 21,000 individuals (on average 7 household members).The beneficiary households will be drought-affected households that depend on agriculture or livestock for their livelihoods (90%). They are generally host community members. This place of origin approach is intended to contribute to an avoidance of further internal displacement. As households who own land and livestock are often not the poorest members of the community, 10% of the food and non-food item cash grants will be distributed to landless households (the poorest of the poor).
